points: \item Built YOLO-based object detection system for National ID authentication, achieving robust counterfeit hologram detection with MiDaS depth estimation and GAN-generated synthetic samples.
\item Optimized security-critical computer vision pipeline by eliminating redundant processing, reducing per-card verification time from 7 minutes to 3 minutes while maintaining high accuracy.
\item Developed ML-based anomaly detection system for MFA workflows using TensorFlow, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25% while maintaining strict security requirements.
\item Applied transfer learning to fine-tune pre-trained models on limited secure datasets, achieving reliable performance across varied authentication scenarios.
\item Containerized and deployed production ML solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring scalable and secure pipelines for identity verification and anomaly detection systems.
\item Implemented LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess model reliability across hundreds of examples, ensuring production-ready performance for security-sensitive applications.
